description: Show or TIGHTEN the local wallet's spend policy (per-call USD cap, 24h USD cap, recipient allowlist, kill-switch). action=show (default) prints the effective policy and 24h usage. action=set can only LOWER caps, NARROW the allowlist, never raise/widen them; action=kill engages the kill-switch (stops every spend immediately). Raising limits or releasing the kill-switch must be done by the human operator (FINCH_* env vars / deleting ~/.finch/spend.OFF); this tool cannot.

allowlist.description: Recipient allowlist (0x…). Must be a subset of the current allowlist if one exists.

maxPerCallUsd.description: New per-call cap in USD (must be <= current)

maxPerDayUsd.description: New rolling-24h cap in USD (must be <= current)

name: wallet_policy
